subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel text acknowledgement contract, keep this as channel-specific placeholder work, or decline text acknowledgements in favor of reactions/typing/status signals?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but solving it adds new visible messaging behavior and config/API surface across multiple channels, which requires maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Design a Generic Ack-Text Contract
options.body: Add a default-off messages-level ack text or non-terminal acknowledgement hook with scope and per-channel/account override rules, then update schema, docs, and channel tests.

options.title: Scope to Channel Placeholders
options.body: Keep this issue as umbrella context while Slack, Telegram, Discord, and other channels implement their own default-off placeholder lifecycles where product demand justifies it.

options.title: Decline Text Acknowledgements
options.body: Document that OpenClaw supports reactions, typing, and status reactions for pre-reply feedback, and close or route the channel-specific placeholder requests accordingly.

recommendation.title: Design a Generic Ack-Text Contract
recommendation.body: Add a default-off messages-level ack text or non-terminal acknowledgement hook with scope and per-channel/account override rules, then update schema, docs, and channel tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest combined history across reply lifecycle, typing/ack reaction behavior, plugin dispatch seams, and prior review of this exact issue.
